d:
A colossal demonic entity with deep charcoal skin and a singular, glowing golden eye embedded in the center of the forehead. The body is heavily muscled with obsidian-colored plating and jagged horns protruding from the head. Large, leathery wings of a dark slate grey extend from the back, and the tail is a thick, spiked appendage of the same charcoal hue. Each hand has four thick, clawed fingers.
BODY COLOR: deep charcoal
